name: krw-guru-advisor
description: Explicit investor-guru consultation skill that uses guru ontology as an investing lens and KRW Ontology filing research as company-fact evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Explicit guru-style investor consultation using separate guru ontology plus filing evidence.
interface.longDescription: Provides a separately installed, explicitly invoked consultation skill and read-only Guru MCP. Guru ontology supplies investor lenses, questions, and risk frames; KRW Ontology filing research remains the source for company facts. This plugin is not added to the KRW Ontology router.
defaultPrompt: Use $krw-guru-buffett-advisor: 내가 AAPL을 샀는데 이 렌즈로 점검해줘.
Use $krw-guru-marks-advisor: 이 기업을 리스크 중심으로 봐줘.
Use $krw-guru-terry-smith-advisor: 이 회사를 왜 거절할 수 있을지 봐줘.
